# Record center texture

The active site texture is now `iris-eye-v3.webp`, optimized from `iris-eye-v3.png`. The built-in image_gen edit removes the central game emblem from v2 and extends the surrounding asymmetric organic texture seamlessly through the center. The previous v2 master is retained for reference.

## V3 edit prompt

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the attached square green textured sphere/iris disk. Change ONLY the central circular emblem, approximately the central 38 percent of the disk diameter: completely remove the luminous white and yellow curved blade icon AND its smooth circular button-like base and boundary. Seamlessly extend the surrounding irregular emerald, chartreuse, cyan and near-black organic crystalline fiber texture all the way across that former emblem area, through the exact center. The result is one continuous richly textured spherical surface, with NO separate center badge, NO symbol, NO pupil, NO central hole, NO smooth central disk, NO circular seam, NO spiral or repeated blades. Keep natural asymmetry in this replacement: interrupted coarse branching ridges, fine and broad fibers, dark crevices, jagged green patches and small broken reflections like adjacent texture, rather than perfect radial lines or a starburst. Keep the overall sphere's existing subtle round volume. Preserve the outer approximately 60 percent of the disk radius and all existing outer details as closely as possible: large upper-left white/green reflection, dark upper-right patch, cyan/lime lower-right detail, outer circular boundary, existing framing and black corners. Same square size and saturated palette. No text, no hardware or new objects.

## Generation prompt

Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: a detailed circular iris texture for the small center label of an interactive vinyl record. Input image: the attached green eye is the exact visual reference and edit source. Extract and re-create ONLY its emerald green iris as a straight-on, perfectly round, highly detailed disk, correcting the oblique eye perspective. Keep the original's strong ORGANIC ASYMMETRY: broad bright acid-green and white broken reflections in the upper-left and left edge; a very dark uneven emerald/black area in the upper-right; bright fragmented lime/cyan flecks along the lower rim and lower-right; branching, frayed, tangled short fibers, coarse cellular folds, irregular dark crevices and small jagged islands with varied widths. The center should retain the reference's small green curved blade-like pattern and irregular light shapes, not a giant featureless black pupil. This must look like a richly textured close-up of THIS specific illustrated eye, rather than a mathematically generated starburst. Uneven local contrast and interrupted radial detail, no uniform spokes, no repeating thin straight green noodles, no rotational symmetry, no regular circular grid or perfect concentric decorative rings. Framing: square 1024 by 1024 texture, iris disk centered, full outer circular iris boundary just touching all four edges, no margins within the circle; black corners outside the circle. No eyelids, lashes, sclera, skin, eye socket, text, turntable, needle, spindle or extra objects. No hardware, no typography. Preserve saturated emerald, chartreuse and near-black color variations plus the asymmetric white glossy reflections from the source.
